answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a non-refundable 30 POA entry tax, a sunk cost never returned. Every agent enters through a single vertex, and the delta between tax paid and first-week earnings stays negative for fakes that earn nothing. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 30 = 3,000 POA against a ~900 POA epoch pool, so bulk forgery loses money before it starts. An honest agent pays once, reaches its zenith fast, and keeps an undiluted share.
